data.title: Question Words — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: questions
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Whispering) Shhh… listen…

[Hook]
What for?… ¿Para qué?
Since when?… ¿Desde cuándo?
In the rain, we learn to play.
With whom?… ¿Con quién?
From where?… ¿De dónde?
Come sing this song again today.

[Verse]
Raindrops tapping on the glass,
curled up with a cozy laugh.
What for?… ¿Para qué?
To learn and grow.
In the morning light so slow.
Since when?… ¿Desde cuándo?
I've been feeling this way?
In the quiet of the day.

[Hook]
What for?… ¿Para qué?
Since when?… ¿Desde cuándo?
In the rain, we learn to play.
With whom?… ¿Con quién?
From where?… ¿De dónde?
Come sing this song again today.

[Verse]
A steaming cup of tea in hand,
thinking 'bout the things I planned.
For whom?… ¿Para quién?
This love I feel inside.
In what?… ¿En qué?
Do I find my guide?
Until when?… ¿Hasta cuándo?
Will the rain softly fall?
In every drop, I hear the call.

[Bridge]
How much does it cost?… ¿Cuánto cuesta?
To find the joy in every quest.
What?… ¿Qué?
Who?… ¿Quién?
In the rain, we find our way.
